currency.title: Default currency
currency.hint: It's preselected when you create a new account, budget or goal — each one keeps its own currency afterwards; they're never mixed into one total.

enabled.title: Enabled currencies
enabled.hint: Like picking languages in a translator: search and check the ones you actually use — they're the only ones you'll be able to pick when creating an account, budget or goal.
enabled.inUse: You can't turn off {{code}}: you still have accounts, budgets or goals in that currency.

travel.title: Travel mode
travel.hint: While it's on, every expense, income and transfer you record is tagged with your trip's tag automatically, so you can see them all together later.
travel.name: Trip name
travel.active: Trip on: your new transactions are being tagged “{{name}}”.
